item.title: MSRB authorizes staff to harmonize gifts rule with FINRA proposal
item.description: "MSRB is committed to ensuring our regulatory framework keeps pace with an evolving market," MSRB Board Chair Natasha Holiday said.

item.title: Chicago Transit Authority plans return to market with $575M deal
item.description: Wells Fargo Securities will price for the Chicago Transit Authority $575 million of first and second lien sales tax receipts bonds on Thursday, Feb. 5.

item.title: Munis quiet, short-term USTs see gains
item.description: Munis were largely unchanged this week and tax-exempts continue to be "quite unattractive" at current levels, said Barclays strategists led by Mikhail Foux.

item.title: MTA's capital cost efficiency push to be tested by funding threats
item.description: The Metropolitan Transportation Authority's ability to finish projects on budget will become more crucial as federal, state and economic pressures mount.

item.title: January issuance falls but remains above 10-year average
item.description: Issuance was $34.308 billion in 471 issues, down 7.2% year-over-year from $36.982 billion across 536 transactions in 2025. However, this was the third-highest monthly figure for January and above the month's 10-year average of $29.699 billion

item.title: White House weighing in on state income tax
item.description: The White House releases a report that leans into ending state income tax while tax experts question the math used to make the case.

item.title: Treasury taps former PNC public finance chief Dailey for key muni office
item.description: "I was in banking for a long time and this gives me a chance to support the market from another angle," said Rob Dailey.

item.title: Munis steady to start February, USTs see losses
item.description: The market is well-positioned for February, after January's near-record tax-exempt supply, said J.P. Morgan strategists led by Peter DeGroot.

item.title: Moody's downgrades Indiana's Parkview Health System to A1
item.description: Moody's Ratings downgraded Parkview Health System's revenue bond rating one notch, to A1 from Aa3, on Friday. It also revised the outlook to stable.

item.title: GOP blames California electeds for wildfires in hearings
item.description: Wisconsin Republican Ron Johnson formed a Senate subcommittee to investigate the Los Angeles fires at the request of Sen. Rick Scott, R-Fla.
